dataset_name: Budget vs Actual Variance Navigator - Canonical Intelligence Data
description: Canonical financial measurement dataset standardized from 18 synthetic source observations. Each source observation produces four metric rows; the 72 canonical rows are not 72 independent transactions. Forecast values are illustrative source figures, not validated model predictions.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Unique canonical record identifier generated from the source row and metric name.

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: Classification of the canonical record. Constant value for financial metric observations.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: Reporting month from the source Month field, converted to the first day of the month in ISO 8601 UTC.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Cost-centre identifier copied from the source cost_centre field.

columns.name: related_entity_id
columns.description: Optional identifier linking this record to another entity. Not supplied by the source.

columns.name: entity_name
columns.description: Department name copied from the source department field.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Account category copied from the source account_category field.

columns.name: subcategory
columns.description: Optional subcategory. Not supplied by the source dataset.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Optional financial or workflow status. Not supplied by the source dataset.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Optional process stage. Not supplied by the source dataset.

columns.name: metric_name
columns.description: Name of the financial measure represented by this canonical record; derived from a source amount column.

columns.name: metric_value
columns.description: Numeric financial amount copied from the corresponding source amount column.

columns.name: metric_unit
columns.description: Currency unit used for the financial metric. The canonical dataset uses USD.

columns.name: text_value
columns.description: Optional descriptive text. No text observations are supplied in the source dataset.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Optional geographic latitude. No geographic coordinates are supplied in the source dataset.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Optional geographic longitude. No geographic coordinates are supplied in the source dataset.

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: Path identifying the original source file for provenance.

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.description: Generated source-row identifier linking the four canonical measurements to their original source observation.

columns.name: is_synthetic
columns.description: Boolean indicator identifying the dataset as synthetic rather than real operational data.

columns.name: data_version
columns.description: Version identifier assigned to the canonical dataset.
